competences.description: Attacks the enemy to leave a Branding effect for 2 turns with a 50% chance. The damage increases according to your MAX HP.

effets.description: The target will receive 25% increased damage.

competences.description: Increases the Attack Power of the ally with the highest Attack Power for 1 turn and teams up with the ally to attack the enemy. While attacking, your attack deals damage 2 times, decreasing its Defense for 2 turns with a 50% chance each.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be increased by 50%.
effets.note: Of the ally with the highest Attack Power

effets.description: Brings one or more allies to attack at the same time.
effets.note: Of the ally with the highest Attack Power

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Goes under the Threat state while enemies attack with a single-target skill 2 times, and then attacks all enemies to deal damage proportionate to your MAX HP and stun them for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The enemy can only attack the target under the Threat state when using the attack skill. The duration of the Threat will be reduced only by skills that attack a single enemy target. The target under the Threat state will be inflicted with 15% less damage when attacked.
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
